entities.name: Marvin L. Cohen

entities.summary: Marvin Lou Cohen is an American–Canadian theoretical physicist. He is a physics professor at the University of California, Berkeley. Cohen is an expert in the field of condensed matter physics. He is widely known for his seminal work on the electronic structure of solids.
